baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun النفس is the addressee and المطمئنة is its feminine singular modifier.
baseline_models.mechanism: The address selects the life-bearing self and names its achieved condition as settled calm after disturbance.

activation_trace.role: The living soul-self supplies the animate identity directly summoned by the vocative.
Settled calm supplies the addressee's attained condition and implies prior agitation as its contrast.

changed_reading.before: A soul is merely described as calm.
changed_reading.after: The living self is personally summoned in the condition of having come to rest after disturbance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: النفس can mark the very identity or essence of the addressed one, not only a passing psychic state.
baseline_models.mechanism: The adjective reaches the whole identity: calm has penetrated to the self's core rather than remaining an emotion laid over it.

activation_trace.role: The very thing itself supplies an essential rather than merely affective scope for النفس.
Settled calm functions as a stable quality of that whole identity.

changed_reading.before: The addressee happens to feel tranquil.
changed_reading.after: The addressee is addressed at the level of its whole, settled identity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus noun carries breath and relief branches while its modifier carries settling after agitation.
baseline_models.mechanism: A respiratory-material reading coexists with the personal one: constriction has been given room, breath can leave freely, and the self is calm because it is no longer held tight.

activation_trace.role: Breath leaving the body gives النفس a rhythmic, embodied substrate.
Relief by making breathing room turns calm into release from constriction.
Settling after agitation supplies the endpoint of the release.

changed_reading.before: Calm is an abstract inward mood.
changed_reading.after: Calm is also the body's recovered breathing room, an unforced breath after constriction.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The adjective's inventory includes physical lowering, while النفس can denote self-regard, resolve, and inner mettle.
baseline_models.mechanism: The phrase can spatialize composure as proud or strained self-regard bending down into a stable low posture without being degraded.

activation_trace.role: Inner mettle and self-regard supply what can cease straining upward.
Physical lowering supplies an embodied posture of composure rather than an emotion alone.

changed_reading.after: It may also picture a self whose mettle has stopped elevating itself and has settled low without collapse.

context_deltas.mechanism: Dawn splits out of night while night itself travels and clears; this activates the focus branch in which النفس is an opening like daybreak. The calm self is therefore not static darkness but a constriction opening as a traversed night passes.

activation_trace.role: Opening and spreading like dawn makes the focus self itself capable of daybreak.
Settled calm supplies the stable result of that opening.
Daybreak emerging from night supplies the literal transition that activates the focus opening.
Night and its darkness supply the constricted phase from which the reading emerges.
Night travel makes darkness a passing process rather than the self's permanent state.
Uncovering and clearing supplies the release arrow from traversed night to opened self.

structural_cues: The opening oath moves from dawn through nights to night in motion before the later direct address.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dawn, darkness, night travel, clearing, and a focus branch that explicitly opens like dawn. I infer a process from constriction through passage to settlement; a live alternative is that the oath images remain cosmological and do not describe the addressee.

changed_reading.before: The tranquil self is motionless and already complete.
changed_reading.after: The tranquil self is a dawn-like opening achieved by passing through darkness, so its rest contains completed movement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Joining and singularity, followed by allotment and a restraining boundary, suggest composure as a fitted internal order. The self settles because paired and unpaired elements can retain their measures without invading one another.

activation_trace.role: The whole identity supplies the bounded whole whose differentiated parts are being modeled.
Settled calm is recast as composure produced by a stable internal arrangement.
Joining a thing to its like supplies relation and pairing within the arrangement.
The unpaired singular supplies a remainder that can stay whole without forced pairing.
Allotting portions supplies measured differentiation rather than undirected fragmentation.
Restraining reason supplies the boundary that keeps the differentiated whole composed.

structural_cues: Pair and odd are juxtaposed, then the oath is tested for one possessing a restraining intellect.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pairing, singularity, apportionment, and restraint. I infer that these form an anatomy of composure inside the focus self; alternatively they may function only as oath objects and epistemic qualification.

changed_reading.before: Calm is an undifferentiated absence of conflict.
changed_reading.after: Calm can be a measured whole in which joined, singular, and bounded elements coexist without erasing one another.

context_deltas.mechanism: Tall supports, cut rock, and peg-like fixation build an image of rigid elevation; exceeding limits and leaving right order expose that monumentality as unstable. Against it, the focus self's physical lowering reads as relinquished self-monument rather than weakness.

activation_trace.role: Self-regard and pride supply the inward analogue of monumental elevation.
Physical lowering supplies the focus self's counter-posture to rigid height.
Height and elevation in pillars supply the vertical ambition being internalized as self-monument.
Great hard rock supplies rigidity and apparent permanence.
Peg-like erection and fixation supply an image of aggressively secured standing.
Exceeding the limit makes elevation an ethical overreach rather than neutral architecture.
Departure from sound order supplies the failure mode of the rigid elevated system.

structural_cues: The destroyed peoples are described through exceptional construction before their transgression and multiplied corruption are named.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies vertical, hard, fixed structures and then limit-breaking disorder. I map their public architecture onto the focus branch of self-regard and infer that lowering reverses self-monumentalization; alternatively the historical structures need not model an interior posture.

changed_reading.before: A lowered self would sound humiliated or depleted.
changed_reading.after: The settled-low self may be the one no longer building its identity as an elevated, rigid monument.

context_deltas.mechanism: Provision is narrowed as a test, but the human converts that material lowering into a verdict of humiliation. The split ه و ن inventory holds both contemptuous weakness and calm dignity in gentleness, allowing المطمئنة to name the self that undergoes restriction without accepting the false verdict.

activation_trace.role: Settled calm supplies the non-reactive condition maintained under material change.
Physical lowering supplies the shared spatial image that need not equal degradation.
Testing that reveals a condition makes restricted provision diagnostic rather than a final valuation.
Narrowing to a small measure supplies the concrete reduction that provokes the mistaken judgment.
Contemptible weakness supplies the devaluing interpretation voiced by the tested human.
The non-dominant mapped branch of calm dignity in gentleness supplies a live reversal inside the same cue.

structural_cues: The matched abundance and restriction scenes are both called tests, and the devaluation claim is rejected by كَلَّا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies testing, narrowed measure, a voiced humiliation judgment, and a split branch preserving gentle dignity. I infer that the focus calm is the capacity not to turn reduction into self-devaluation; alternatively the split branch may be lexically remote from أهانن and only contrastive.

changed_reading.before: The tranquil self is calm because its circumstances confirm its honor.
changed_reading.after: The tranquil self can be materially lowered yet retain gentle dignity, refusing to mistake restriction for humiliation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus branch of relief by giving space becomes social and material. Honor withheld from the cut-off child and food not mobilized toward the immobilized poor show that a genuinely settled self does not seal its calm inside itself; it helps another life regain room and stability.

activation_trace.role: Relief by giving breath and space supplies the focus self's outwardly transferable calm.
Settled calm supplies the stable agency from which relief can be extended.
Honorable generosity supplies the positive action explicitly withheld from the orphan.
A child cut off from a protector supplies the social constriction requiring relief.
Urging toward action supplies the missing collective movement rather than private sentiment.
Feeding another supplies the material form taken by breath-giving relief.
Sustenance that stabilizes dwelling turns the poor person's stillness into a condition that can be supported.

structural_cues: After rejecting the honor and humiliation calculus, the text immediately names failures toward the orphan and poor in second-person plural.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies negated failures of honor, urging, and feeding, plus focus relief by making room. I infer their reversal as the social mechanism of a settled self; alternatively these commands may only contrast the addressee with others and not define its tranquility.

changed_reading.before: The tranquil self possesses a private interior peace.
changed_reading.after: Its peace is porous and distributive: it gives room, honor, and sustaining support to lives made constricted or still.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus inventory already places preciousness, rivalry, envy, and withholding inside النفس. The context then depicts inherited value consumed wholesale and wealth loved into amassed fullness. Calm becomes a reorganization of desire in which value no longer demands competitive capture and total incorporation.

activation_trace.role: Precious value desired and competed for supplies the appetite latent inside the focus noun.
Settled calm supplies desire's release from rivalry and acquisitive agitation.
Consuming and taking wealth supplies the mechanism by which value is absorbed into the self.
Transfer from predecessor to heir supplies value that should pass between persons rather than terminate in one appetite.
Gathering dispersed things into one mass supplies indiscriminate accumulation.
Love lodged in the heart supplies the adhesive force behind accumulation.
Acquiring and multiplying property supplies the chosen object and direction of desire.
Accumulation until fullness supplies the endpoint of appetite that never gives value onward.

structural_cues: Eating and love are each intensified by cognate or emphatic constructions, making appetite repetitive and totalizing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a focus branch of rivalry for precious value and a context sequence of consuming, gathering, loving, and filling. I infer that tranquility is desire freed from compulsory accumulation; alternatively the focus self may be contrasted with these appetites without the root branch defining its transformation.

changed_reading.before: Tranquility means having enough valued goods to stop worrying.
changed_reading.after: Tranquility means value no longer agitates the self into rivalry, consumption, and amassed fullness.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated pulverizing levels the earth, then repeated rows impose a new alignment. The physical lowering branch of المطمئنة becomes readiness for leveling: the self whose pride is already low does not need to preserve itself as a protruding structure when the shared ground is flattened.

activation_trace.role: Self-regard supplies the inward height exposed to leveling.
Physical lowering supplies anticipatory conformity to the leveled ground.
Pounding and demolition to levelness supplies the force that removes protruding forms.
The lower realm opposite the sky supplies the common plane to which forms return.
Alignment on a level line supplies ordered equality after leveling.

structural_cues: Both دك and صف are repeated, first intensifying the removal of unevenness and then the formation of ordered rows.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies literal leveling, lower earth, and aligned rows. I infer that the focus self's low posture is an interior anticipation of that common order; alternatively the physical branch may remain only a lexical echo with no ethical direction.

changed_reading.before: The calm self is exempted from the world's disruption.
changed_reading.after: The calm self is already compatible with leveling: it can lose elevation without losing identity and enter a shared order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human remembers only at the decisive time and regrets not advancing something for 'my life.' Because النفس can be inner intention and living self, its settled form can be read as memory, intent, and life integrated before remembrance becomes unusably late.

activation_trace.role: Inner thought and hidden intent supply the interior material that can be remembered and integrated.
The living soul-self anchors the contrast between present life and the life recognized in regret.
Settled calm supplies coherence between memory, intention, and action.
Recovering something after forgetting supplies memory's belated return.
The proper time or moment supplies the temporal threshold beyond which memory cannot repair action.
Advancing something ahead supplies enacted intention rather than inward recollection alone.
Life as benefit and good supplies the fuller life for which timely action matters.

structural_cues: Remembrance, its unavailability, regret, advance, and 'my life' form one tightly ordered speech sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies late remembrance, a timing question, regret over what was not advanced, and focus branches of inner intent and living self. I infer that settlement is timely integration that prevents belated self-division; alternatively the address may identify a rewarded soul without describing how its calm formed.

changed_reading.before: The tranquil soul is simply a postmortem identity.
changed_reading.after: It is also the self whose memory, intention, and living action became coherent before the decisive moment made recollection futile.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus address, وثق holds two opposed stabilizations: trusting rest in what is relied upon and a fastening that immobilizes. The focus calm is thus distinguished from coerced stillness; it is freely grounded reliance, not the quiet of a bound body.

activation_trace.role: Settled reassurance supplies voluntary inward rest.
Resolve and inner mettle preserve agency inside the settled state.
The fastening bond supplies coerced immobility as the immediate negative neighbor of calm.
Trust and resting in what is reliable supply an unforced alternative within the same root.
Total negation intensifies the unique binding and sharpens the contrast with the singular self then addressed.

structural_cues: The punishment and binding clauses immediately precede the feminine singular vocative, creating a hard boundary between two kinds of stillness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies physical fettering and trustful reliance under one root directly before settled reassurance. I infer a deliberate contrast between forced immobility and chosen grounding; alternatively the juxtaposition may only separate condemned and saved addressees.

changed_reading.before: Tranquility could be indistinguishable from passivity or immobilization.
changed_reading.after: The self is still because it trusts what is reliable, not because its agency has been fastened down.

context_deltas.mechanism: The direct vocative is followed by a return command, while رجع can also be the return of speech or an echo. The address can therefore be heard as performative recall: it does not merely identify an already calm self but elicits the answering movement that displays its calm.

activation_trace.role: The self in its very identity supplies the one personally reached by the call.
Settled relation supplies the non-resistant responsiveness of the one called.
Uttered speech supplies the audible field against which the later direct summons stands.
Return to what was supplies the commanded movement elicited by the vocative.
Returning an answer turns physical return into a possible response to address.
Echoed voice supplies the exploratory image of the summoned self returning the call through movement.

structural_cues: A direct feminine vocative is immediately followed by a feminine singular imperative of return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direct address, uttered speech, return, returned answer, and echo. I infer that the call helps enact the return and that responsiveness evidences calm; alternatively the vocative may only introduce a command whose execution is conceptually separate.

changed_reading.before: يا أيتها النفس المطمئنة is a static label before an unrelated command.
changed_reading.after: The address is a recall that the settled self can answer, so calm appears as responsive movement toward the caller.

context_deltas.mechanism: Return is toward a Lord whose branch includes nurturing completion, and the destination state is grammatically doubled as being pleased and pleasing. The focus calm expands from unilateral inner serenity into a completed reciprocal relation of acceptance, love, and reliable belonging.

activation_trace.role: Settling in relation to something supplies the relational capacity of the focus adjective.
Inner intention supplies the self's side of the reciprocal relation.
Nurture, repair, and completion supply the relation's formative rather than merely possessive direction.
Mutual satisfaction supplies the two-way acceptance made visible by the paired participles.
The non-dominant mapped branch joins obedience, love, and guarantee as possible textures of dependable belonging.

structural_cues: The active and passive رضا forms stand side by side after 'to your Lord,' preserving both directions of relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nurture and paired active-passive acceptance. I infer that these reveal what the focus self is settled into, with reciprocity completing its calm; alternatively راضية and مرضية may list two rewards without defining المطمئنة.

changed_reading.before: Tranquility is a self-contained emotional possession.
changed_reading.after: Tranquility is stable reciprocity: the self rests in a nurturing relation in which it accepts and is accepted.

context_deltas.mechanism: The self is told to enter twice, first into a human relation of service and then into a protected garden. Settlement is therefore not self-enclosure: the stable identity crosses a social threshold before a spatial one and finds concealment as protection rather than isolation.

activation_trace.role: The whole self supplies an identity stable enough to enter relations without dissolution.
Settled calm supplies portable stability across both thresholds.
Literal entry supplies the first crossing into the community of servants.
Humble obedience supplies the shared relation constituting that community.
Honor and magnification keep service from collapsing into the earlier image of humiliation.
Interpenetrating parts supplies a stronger image of belonging within, not merely arrival at, the second destination.
A garden concealed by trees supplies the concrete sheltered destination.
Protective covering makes concealment a form of safety rather than withdrawal.

structural_cues: The repeated imperative enters first 'among My servants' and only then 'My garden.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two ordered entries, a servant relation, and protected concealment. I infer that social belonging precedes and helps specify spatial shelter; alternatively the two imperatives may be parallel admissions with no causal priority.

changed_reading.before: A tranquil self withdraws from relation into a private paradise.
changed_reading.after: Its stable identity permits deeper belonging: first within an honored serving community, then within protective garden shelter.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus occurrence النفس ordinarily points to self or soul, not childbirth. It remains packet-anchored through the supplied birth branch, the feminine singular address, return, entry, and fetal concealment; downstream prose should present it only as a material reversal or second-birth analogy, not a lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus noun has a childbirth and postpartum branch, and the addressee is feminine singular.

activation_trace.role: Birth and postpartum emergence supply the outward first movement that the later return can reverse.
Return to a prior state supplies the reversal from emergence back toward origin.
Entry supplies the inward direction of the reversed birth movement.
The fetus concealed in the womb supplies the protective gestational analogue for re-entry.

changed_reading.before: The soul simply departs one realm and arrives in another.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the feminine self reverses birth: what once emerged is recalled inward into a protective second gestation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain hydrologic reading is surprising because it combines remote physical branches rather than the ordinary senses of the surface words. It remains anchored in the focus adjective's low-ground branch and the focus noun's sustaining-water branch, reinforced by gathered water, returning rain, revived earth, and growing enclosure; render it as an ecological analogy, not a claim that المطمئنة literally means a basin.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus adjective can image depressed ground, while النفس can image life-sustaining water.

activation_trace.role: Low or depressed ground supplies the receptive shape of the self.
Life-sustaining water supplies what the receptive self can hold without hoarding.
Water gathered in a depression supplies the basin mechanism activated by physical lowering.
Earth revived by rain and vegetation supplies the life-producing consequence of reception.
Returning rain supplies circulation rather than one-way possession.
Entwining, surging vegetation supplies the sheltered growth enabled by received water.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the lowered self is receptive lowland: it gathers returning life, lets it circulate, and becomes capable of sheltered growth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it turns a branch of النفس into an economic contrast rather than identifying the soul with property. It remains anchored in the supplied preciousness branch and the surrounding sequence of wealth-love, accumulation, return, and mutual acceptance; downstream prose should say the self is figured as value released from rivalry, never that it is a commodity.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus noun includes the precious thing for which selves compete.

activation_trace.role: Precious value and rivalry supply the market-like pressure from which the addressed self can be released.
Heart-bound love supplies the attachment that turns value into possession.
Multiplying property supplies the acquisitive economy against which another mode of value appears.
Mutual satisfaction supplies relational valuation without competitive ownership.

changed_reading.before: What is precious must be acquired, amassed, and withheld.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the precious self exits the economy of rivalry and is valued through mutual acceptance rather than possession.

strongest_changes: The dawn and moving-night cues turn tranquility from stasis into an opening completed through passage.
The split ه و ن mapping separates material lowering from humiliation and preserves calm dignity inside restriction.
Orphan, poor, food, inheritance, and wealth cues make calm socially distributive and free desire from accumulation.
The binding cue distinguishes freely grounded trust from coerced immobility.
Return, reciprocal رضا, and doubled entry make tranquility responsive, relational, communal, and protected.
summary.what_was_special: The focus inventories allowed calm to remain simultaneously psychological, respiratory, spatial, ethical, social, and relational. The most productive surprises came from taking physical lowering seriously, retaining non-dominant split-root branches, and letting later imperatives convert a settled adjective into responsive movement.
remaining_uncertainties: The physical-lowering branch of ط م ن is visibly supplied but remains form-distant from the ordinary adjectival reading.
Several causal arrows, especially from public architecture or social failures into the focus self, are abductive contrasts rather than explicit syntax.
The non-dominant split branches for ه و ن and ر ض و are live activators but may not govern their particular surface occurrences.
The birth, lowland-water, and precious-value models should remain analogical outliers rather than merged into a final interpretation.
